name: Random partitions, representation theory and Gromov-Witten theory
summary: Measures on partitions defined by Schur functions are analysed as determinantal point processes, and the same structures compute Gromov-Witten and Hurwitz invariants.

name: Higher composition laws and arithmetic statistics
summary: Gauss's composition of quadratic forms is extended to cubes and higher spaces via prehomogeneous representations, and geometry of numbers counts the resulting number fields and ranks.

name: Geometric complexity theory
summary: Mulmuley-Sohoni proposed attacking P versus NP via orbit closures and representation theory.

name: Cluster algebras
summary: Mutation rules on seeds generate algebras whose combinatorics matches total positivity and canonical bases in Lie theory.

name: Heegaard Floer homology
summary: Holomorphic-disc counts in symmetric products of Heegaard surfaces give invariants of three-manifolds and knots with strong genus bounds.

name: Unique games conjecture
summary: A conjecture about label cover instances yields tight hardness for many problems via Fourier-analytic dictatorship tests and SDP integrality gaps.

name: Higher topos theory
summary: Quasicategory-based infinity-topoi and derived geometry reframed homotopy theory and moduli problems.

name: AKS primality
from: algebra of polynomial rings over finite fields
summary: Agrawal, Kayal and Saxena gave an unconditional deterministic polynomial-time primality test using polynomial congruences.

name: Sphere packing in dimensions 8 and 24
summary: A modular-form construction produces the magic function required by the Fourier linear programming bound, matching the E8 and Leech lattice packing densities.

name: Measure rigidity and arithmetic quantum unique ergodicity
summary: Entropy and measure-rigidity methods for diagonal group actions show that Hecke eigenfunctions on arithmetic surfaces do not concentrate, a quantum chaos statement.
